Carcinoma of colon. 
Surgery: Laparotomy F/B extended right hemicolectomy (16.06.2020); VATS metastasectomy in upper lobe of left lung (25.10.2021); Lobectomy in upper lobe of left lung (06.03.2022). FNAC/Biopsy (03.10.2021): CT guided FNAC (chest): containing malignant tumor cell. Histopathology (06.03.2022): Left upper lobe tumor: moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma of GI origin; soft tissue: adenocarcinoma, moderately differentiated. (25.10.2021): Left upper lobe lung specimen: Metastatic adenocarcinoma of GI origin. (16.10.2020): Right hemicolectomy specimen: Moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma, pT3N2bMx. Chemotherapy: 20 cycles, completed on 20.11.2022.
Current PET-CT scan shows: 
FDG avid area (SUVmax: 12.1; about 44 x 18 x 60 mm) at the site of anastomosis - needs colonoscopic evaluation. 
Small low FDG avid area (SUVmax: 2.3; size: 14 x 10 mm) in left lung at the site of operation; might be due to post operative changes. 
No other suspicious mass or abnormal FDG uptake elsewhere in the body surveyed.

The ileo-transverse anastomosis is noted at 100 cm from the anal verge. The anastomotic line is healthy. No evidence of any growth recurrence is seen. The mucosa, vascular patternaa in the lumen of the terminal ileum, rest of the colon and rectum appeared healthy.

In a case of moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma of ascending colon with lung mets, underwent laparotomy followed by extended right hemicolectomy, metastectomy and left upper lobectomy, followed by radio- chemotherapy, compared with previous PET-CT scan done on 14.06.2023, current PET-CT scan shows: 
No definite evidence of recurrent mass or abnormal FDG uptake at the site of hemicolectomy. 
Evidence of left upper lobectomy with ipsilateral shifting and volume shrinkage, consolidation is evident at the left upper part with mild FDG uptake (SUVmax:4.8)-could be benign aetiology. 
Left sided mild pleural thickening at the upper part, no focal or diffuse FDG uptake. 4. Complete morphometabolic regression of left paraaortic lymph node at the level of the aortic arch. 
Mild hepatomegaly without any focal lesion or abnormal FDG uptake. 
Marked degenerative change in the spine along with osteopenia, no abnormal focal or diffuse FDG uptake in the spine. 
Persisting mild diffuse FDG uptake (SUVmax: 6.3) in the posterior wall of the left ventricle-needs further evaluation & clinical correlation to exclude ischaemic heart disease. 
Mild FDG uptake (SUVmax: 5.1) in the left shoulder joint capsule-capsulitis. 
No other suspicious new lesion or appreciable abnormal FDG uptake elsewhere in the body surveyed. 
Overall impression: Good chemotherapeutic response.

IMPRESSION: Known case of carcinoma of colon and metastatic carcinoma of left lung, underwent operation followed by chemotherapy, compared with previous PET-CT scan done on 02.05.2024, current PET-CT scan shows:
No evidence of abnormal FDG uptake or recurrent mass in right hemicolectomy site.
Status post upper lobectomy of left lung; no definite FDG avid mass lesion in preserved portion of left lung; however, mild metabolic regression of previously seen fibrosis with mild FDG uptake might be post-operative change.
Mild left sided pleural thickening.
No other suspicious mass or abnormal FDG uptake elsewhere in the body surveyed

Known case of adenocarcinoma transverse colon with liver metastasis pT4aN2bM1. Post right hemicolectomy 31st August 2021. Post 4 cycles of CAPOX-December 2021. Post 1 cycle of Irinotecan and Capecitabine-1/2/2022. For follow up. 
Post right hemicolectomy status with no definite focal lesion at the anastomotic site. 
Diffuse peritoneal thickening and omental nodularity with mild ascites and retroperitoneal lymph nodes showing increased FDG uptake. 
Post hepatic metastatectomy status with ill-defined hypodense surface nodularity along the left lobe of liver showing patchy increased FDG uptake-likely surface deposits. 
No demonstrable metabolically active disease elsewhere in the whole body survey.
